tagline: A railroad bridge found another kind of traffic.
intro: From Greer, laid out in 1836 as Greersville, the byway follows US 62 and Route 514 through Danville and Millwood toward Martinsburg, out into Amish country. Between Danville and Brinkhaven, the Mohican Valley Trail runs alongside on the bed of the old Pennsylvania Railroad.

Brinkhaven, on the Mohican River, has also gone by Nonpareil, Mount Holly and Gann. After the rail line was abandoned, local people turned it into the trail, which opened in 2001 and runs from Danville to the Holmes County line.

moments.title: Bridge of Dreams
moments.text: When locals proposed roofing the 370-foot railroad bridge, skeptics said they were dreaming; it was covered in 1998, and walkers, cyclists and Amish buggies cross it now.

moments.title: Artanna
moments.text: The name joins Art and Anna Wolfe, whose gas station opened here in the early 1930s; for a time the couple kept cabins for travelers too.

moments.title: Martinsburg
moments.text: The rival towns of Hanover and Williamsburg settled their differences in 1828 by merging into one village.
